'''Skyholme''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]]. Established by the planet's [[colonists]] when the planet was first settled, Skyholme was established in a mountainous region, and was the annual meeting place of the [[Skyholme Astromancers|Astromancer]] conclave.
